name: Sexuality
overview: Scripture reveals that God created sexuality as a sacred union between one man and one woman, designed to become "one flesh" in marriage (Genesis 2:24; Matthew 19:4). Sexual relations outside this divine pattern, including same-sex relations, are clearly condemned as abominations (Leviticus 18:22; Leviticus 20:13; Romans 1:26). Furthermore, Jesus teaches that lustful intent itself is sinful, equating it with adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28), underscoring the call to holiness in both thought and action regarding sexuality.
